description: Data Basin is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Conservation Biology Institute; Wilburforce Foundation; Kresge Foundation. Data Basin is a science-based mapping and analysis platform that supports learning, research, and sustainable environmental stewardship. The platform is used by interested citizens, students and educators, natural resource practitioners, and scientists from diverse sectors and geographies. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Changing Seasons, Drought, Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
